tagline.en: Vodafone-based UK MVNO — £5 top-up per 90 days, Wi-Fi Calling
tagline.zh: Vodafone网络英国虚商——充5镑延90天，支持Wi-Fi Calling

description.en: Lebara is an international MVNO running on Vodafone UK's network. Order eSIM directly on the official site; after 90 consecutive days without top-up or chargeable usage you lose any remaining balance, while the number itself is terminated only after a further 365 days of inactivity — cheap per event but a 2x/year cadence to protect your credit. Wi-Fi Calling supported; a China-roaming data bundle was briefly offered and then withdrawn.
description.zh: Lebara是走Vodafone英国网络的国际虚商。官网可直接下单eSIM；连续90天无充值或计费使用会失去剩余余额，但号码本身要再连续365天不活跃才被终止——单次便宜，但为保住余额一年要充两次。支持Wi-Fi Calling；曾短暂推出中国漫游流量包后又取消。

details.en:
Lebara's keep-alive is two-tier: after 90 consecutive days without a top-up or chargeable usage you forfeit any remaining credit, but full termination of the number comes only after a further 365 days of inactivity — a missed 90-day window costs money, not immediately the number. £5 per 90 days remains the lowest per-event top-up among reviewed UK options, but at twice-a-year cadence it lands near Lycamobile's £10/90 days and above giffgaff's near-zero SMS route.

It rides Vodafone's infrastructure (good coverage quality), supports Wi-Fi Calling, and sells eSIM directly at checkout. The China-relevant caveat is directional: Lebara briefly launched a China-roaming data bundle and then cancelled it, and its marketing centres on international calls to South Asia — the source review files it in the low-cost/flexible MVNO tier, not the China-roaming tier.

For a UK number kept alive from anywhere with minimal fuss and Vodafone-grade coverage, it works; for mainland-China data use, look at CTExcel/CMLink instead.
details.zh:
Lebara 的保号规则分两层：连续 90 天无充值或计费使用即失去剩余余额，但号码要再连续 365 天不活跃才会被终止协议并断开——错过 90 天窗口损失的是余额，不会立刻丢号。每 90 天 5 英镑仍是本轮英国选项中单次充值门槛最低的，但按一年两次的节奏算下来，总成本与 Lycamobile 的 10 英镑/90天 相近，明显高于 giffgaff 近乎为零的短信路线。

网络与体验：走 Vodafone 网络设施、覆盖质量好，支持 Wi-Fi Calling（对收验证码友好），官网结账时可直接勾选 eSIM，入手流程在低价虚商里属于顺畅的一档。

与中国相关的注意点是方向性的：Lebara 曾短暂上线中国漫游流量包后又取消，营销重心一直在南亚方向的国际化通话——源盘点将其归入低价灵活虚商梯队，而非回国漫游梯队。

结论：要一个在哪儿都能低操心保号、Vodafone 级覆盖的英国号码，它可用；要中国大陆流量，请直接看 CTExcel/CMLink。

note.en: Runs on Vodafone UK. Lebara's own (SEO-style) blog states that when roaming in France traffic exits via a French network — contradicting typical Vodafone home-routing; an ISPreview tester in Portugal only noted odd latency, not IP country. Conflicting evidence, treat exit country as unconfirmed.
note.zh: 走 Vodafone 英国网。Lebara 官方博客（SEO 文风、可靠性存疑）称在法国漫游时流量从法国本地出口，与 Vodafone 母网回程惯例矛盾；ISPreview 葡萄牙实测只提延迟异常未提 IP 国家。证据冲突，出口国家未确认。
